questions.question: If x = 3 + 2sqrt{2}, then the value of sqrt{x} - (1)/(sqrt{x)} is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

x = 3 + 2√2

We have to find the value of √x - 1/√x

**Calculation:**

x = 3 + 2√2

⇒ x = 1 + 2 + 2(√2)(1)

⇒ x = (√2 + 1)²

⇒ √x = √2 + 1

questions.question: If cos 27° = x, then the value of tan 63° is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

cos27° = x

tan63° = ?

**Formula Used:**

**cosθ **= Base/Hypotenuse

tanθ = Perpendicular/Base

Perpendicular² + Base² = Hypotenus²

**Calculation:**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e98226bc4c1843d1c6bece073fe9c237a24bb4c8e0e261d2b5d205b141c5b4c9.png] **

cos27° = x

⇒ AB/BC = x/1

Perpendicular² = Hypotenus² – Base²

⇒ AC² = BC² – AB²

⇒ AC² = 1 – x²

⇒ AC = √(1 – x²)

Therefore, tan63° = AB/AC

⇒ tan63° = x/√(1 – x²)

questions.question: If the diagonal of a cube is sqrt{27} cm, then its volume is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Diagonal of Cube = √27

**Formula Used:**

Diagonal of cube = √3 × Side of cube

Volume of Cube = Side³

**Calculation:**

Diagonal of cube = √3 × Side of cube

⇒ √3 × Side of Cube = √27

⇒ Side of Cube = 3√3/√3

⇒ Side of Cube = 3 cm

**∴ Volume of Cube = 3 × 3 × 3 = 27 cm³**

SP₂ = Rs. 11,600

Profit = SP – CP

Loss = CP – SP

**Calculation:**

Suppose the cost price of the article is CP.

According to question –

⇒ 13,400 – CP = CP – 11,600

⇒ 2CP = 25,000

⇒ CP = 12,500

If the SP is Rs. 14,750, then, the profit will be = Rs. (14,750 – 12,500) = Rs. 2,250

questions.question: What sum of money at compound interest will amount to Rs. 4,630.08 in three years if the rate of interest is 4% for the first year, 5% for the second year and 6% for the third year?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Amount after 3 years = Rs. 4,630.08

Rate of interest for 1, 2 and 3 rd year = 4%, 5% and 6% resp

**Concept used:**

Amount = Prinicpal × (1 + r/100)ⁿ

**Calculation:**

Amount = Principal × (1 + 4/100) × (1 + 5/100) × (1 + 6/100)

Rs. 4,630.08 = Principal × 26/25 × 21/20 × 106/100

Then, Principal = 4,630.08 × 25 × 20 × 100/(26 × 21 × 106) = Rs. 4000

**∴ Principal is Rs. 4000.**

questions.question: In an isosceles triangle ABC, AB = AC and AD is perpendicular to BC at D. If AD = 8 cm and perimeter of ΔABC is 64 cm, then the area of ΔABC is:
questions.solution:
Given 

Δ ABC is an isosceles triangle , AB = AC 

Perimeter = 64 cm

AD = 8 cm 

Formula used

Area of triangle = 1/2 × base × height 

Figure:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b0e6505dffcd71756fdf79bb1f1d52967284998e3c64edf97a1e943fa0a4f628.png] 

Calculation

AD perpendicular to BC ,so ΔADB is right angle triangle

Let, AB = AC = x and BD = y

BD = DC (AD will bisect BC)

Accordingly,

x + x + y + y = 64 = Perimeter

⇒ x + y = 32

⇒ x = 32 - y

From ΔABD,

x2 = y2 + 82

⇒ (32 - y)2 = y2 + 82

⇒ 322 - 64y + y2 = y2 + 64

⇒ 64y = 1024 - 64

⇒ y = 960/64

⇒ y = 15

⇒ BD = 15

Now,

BC = 2 × BD (In isosceles triangle, altitude and median are same)

BC = 2 × 15 = 30 cm 

Area of triangle ABC = 1/2 × 30 × 8 = 120 cm2

∴ Area of triangle ABC is 120 cm2

questions.question: A and B working together can do 45% of the work in 9 days. A alone can do the work in 30 days. How many days will B alone take to do the same work?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A = 30 days

A + B = 45% of work in 9 days

**Calculation:**

A + B = 45% of work in 9 days

A + B = 100% of work will be completed in (9/45) × 100 = 20 days

So, (A + B) together can complete the work in 20 days

A alone can do the work in 30 days.

Suppose the total work is 60 units.

A’s one day work = 60/30 = 2 units

(A+ B)’s one day work = 60/20 = 3 units

∴ B’s one day work = (3 – 2) = 1 unit

So, B alone can do the work in 60/1 = 60 days

Average weight of P, Q and R = 62 kg

P = R – 12

Q = R – 9

**Calculation:**

Average weight of P, Q and R = 62 kg

Total weight of P, Q and R = 62 × 3 = 186 kg
